analysis.one_line_summary: Creator quickly demonstrates styling her curtain bangs with the WavyTalk Thermal Brush to show the instant volume difference.
analysis.full_description: A creator speaks directly to the camera explaining that she will demonstrate the difference on just her bangs. She lifts a section of her front fringe, rolls it inwards using the pink WavyTalk thermal brush, and glides it through while explaining 'we go under'. After releasing the brush, her bangs fall into a voluminous, styled curtain shape. She fluffs her hair, shows the brush to the camera, and remarks on how big of a difference it makes just doing the bangs. A static overlay displays a 10% discount code throughout the clip.
